content.question: What is the purpose of the replay buffer in Deep Q-Learning?
options: It caches the neural network weights between updates, so the online and target networks never diverge from each other.
It stores only the transitions with the highest rewards, so the agent learns exclusively from its most successful episodes.
It stores past experiences and samples random mini-batches from them, breaking correlations between consecutive transitions and stabilizing training.
It keeps a copy of the environment's states so the agent can avoid revisiting them in the future.
content.answer: It stores past experiences and samples random mini-batches from them, breaking correlations between consecutive transitions and stabilizing training.
